items.statement: Within the isolated Int2-a plus SO2 model and reported computational scope, the lower 1,4-addition barrier supports the authors' explanation of the experimentally observed 1,4 regioselectivity and the absence of a 1,2-addition byproduct.
items.expected: The final conclusion states that validated barriers favor 1,4 over 1,2 and connects that result cautiously to the observed product channel, while retaining the stated model limitations.

items.statement: The barrier comparison is mechanistic support rather than a complete proof of the full photoredox catalytic cycle.
items.expected: The report distinguishes the local barrier comparison from a complete catalytic free-energy profile and names relevant sensitivity or scope limitations.
